headline: Black Friday: Broncos @ Steelers on Prime (noon PT), a full NBA Cup night, and college basketball all day.

record.label: Last board (Thu 11/26)
record.note: The Bills beat the Chiefs 13-10 in the rain, so the Under hit (counted twice). The Bears scored a last-second touchdown to win 39-35, which sank Lions +1.5 (counted twice) and the 3-leg parlay. Also hit: Goff over 275.5 yards (313), Texas -8.5, Tennessee-Iowa State Under (139, by half a point), and Oregon +9.5. Misses: Swift's carries (9), St. John's, TCU, SMU, and the Gonzaga-Baylor Over. Kelce's receiving yards couldn't be confirmed yet. The four-day winning streak ends; the board is down about 3.1 units since Oct 2.

notes: Picks labeled 'Extra pick' come from only one source. They're quarter units; bet them small or skip them.
Several college games tipped this morning (Liberty, Memphis, Navy). They're left off because they've already started.
No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and nothing on this board is above a 3.
Bet only what you can afford to lose. Help: 1-800-GAMBLER.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Thursday this tab went 1-1. Today: three NBA picks where two sources agree and none disagree.

straight.reasoning: Dimers (54.2% to cover) and Covers both take Atlanta. The teams have nearly the same record (Hawks 11-6, Celtics 12-6), Atlanta has won four straight, and 9.5 points is a lot for that gap. Playable to +9; skip at +8.5.

Dimers' top NBA pick (63.8% to win, 6.7% edge), and Covers takes the Clippers -2.5. LA has lost six straight, but New Orleans has won only five games all season and is missing guards. Playable to -145 (about 59¢ on Kalshi).

BettingPros and Covers both take Portland. The 12-6 Blazers are top-7 on offense and defense, have recently beaten the 76ers and Spurs, and Golden State is badly short-handed without Curry. Playable to -10; skip at -10.5.

straight.reasoning: Dimers and Covers both take Atlanta. Playable to +9.
Dimers and Covers both pick the Clippers. Playable to -145.
BettingPros and Covers both take Portland. Playable to -10.
Dimers and Covers take Brooklyn: Toronto is without Leonard and Barrett and has failed to cover eight straight. But BettingPros takes Toronto -9.5, so confidence stays at 2. Playable to +7.
Extra pick. Covers: the Knicks have won six straight and are 7-3 at home, and the Heat are 4-4 on the road. OG Anunoby may be out. Playable to -4.
Extra pick, low confidence. Covers: Philly is 7-1 on the road and beat Indiana by six this month, but Embiid is questionable and Jaylen Brown is out. Check Embiid's status first.

props.reasoning: Extra pick. FTN: he's gone under this in three straight games as his shooting cools off, and the Spurs have the 3rd-best defense and allow the fewest free throws in the league. FTN shows a 7% edge.

props.pick: Josh Hart UNDER 24.5 points + rebounds + assists
props.reasoning: Extra pick. FTN: he stayed under this in 11 straight games before his last two, and the line is inflated because Anunoby is likely out. FTN projects 18.8.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Black Friday: Broncos @ Steelers, 12:00 PM PT on Prime Video. Broncos -3.5 to -4.5 (opened -1.5), total 36.5–37.5. Pittsburgh released Aaron Rodgers and Mason Rudolph starts. Wind and rain are possible.

straight.reasoning: Extra pick, split sources. VSiN, Sportsbook Review, and Covers take Denver (8-2, won six straight, 8-2 against the spread), but Yahoo and Goal take Pittsburgh at home. The line has jumped from -1.5, so take -3.5 or better; skip at -4.5.

props.reasoning: Extra pick. VSiN: backup quarterbacks lean on tight ends, and its projection has Freiermuth at 28 yards. Goal also expects Rudolph to throw short. Skip above 22.5.
Extra pick. Goal: Rudolph should rely on checkdowns, and Denver allows the most receiving yards to running backs in the league (49.4 a game). Skip above 17.5.

Extra pick. FanDuel Research: both teams play physical half-court defense. Baylor's game with Gonzaga last night finished at only 136. Playable to 148.5.
Extra pick. Dimers' model gives Niagara a 55.5% chance to cover (5% edge). Playable to +4.
Extra pick. Dimers' model gives the Under a 56.5% chance (5.2% edge). Playable to 174.
